approved_scope.title: Soft-TTL purge never parks or drops a Discord session while its agent run is in flight; the run end counts as activity (SESSION-2, SESSION-WORKTREE-3)
approved_scope.description: Soft-TTL purge never parks or drops a Discord session while its agent run is in flight; the run end counts as activity (SESSION-2, SESSION-WORKTREE-3)
acceptance_criteria: A session whose agent run is in flight (bridge chat, /work, /session start) is never dropped or worktree-parked by the soft-TTL purge on get/getByThread/getByBotMessage/list; the run end refreshes lastActivityAt; an idle session past the TTL after its run still purges and parks; fixture tests with a real temp git repo and injected clock
